thread:
Anya S: quick handoff — i'm out in 5. primary -> Samir K for the next 8h, Matt P will be secondary.
Anya S: status: INF-1234 (cache warmup) resolved at 03:12UTC, rolling patch deployed to production on canaries.
Anya S: still open: retrieved load spikes on embeddings route between 02:40-03:00 UTC that caused ~15% 503s for a small subset of tenants. mitigation in place (fallback to smaller shard + increased retry) but we should follow-up.
Samir K: ack, taking primary. can you paste the quick commands/links i should have?
Anya S: yes — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serving-cache-warmup (look under "post-incident followups").
Anya S: recent tickets: INF-1234 (resolved) https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-1234, new follow-up INF-1240 created for deeper root cause: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-1240
Anya S: tl;dr for INF-1240: under-provisioned KV cache eviction on p3pool when concurrent short sequences spike -> causes cache misses + overload on decoder instances.
Anya S: quick reproduce command (dev cluster):
```
kubectl -n inference exec -it $(kubectl -n inference get pod -l app=loadgen -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- ./loadgen --profile embeddings --concurrency 80 --seq 64
```
Samir K: got it. i'll monitor key metrics: token-latency p99, decoder CPU, cache eviction rate. which grafana dash?
Anya S: dashboards: infra -> inference-serving -> "KV cache health" and app -> serving-> "embeddings latency by tenant". saved query: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/inference/kv-cache-health?orgId=1
Matt P: i'm secondary but heads up i might be offline 1-2h at 07:00UTC for a meeting. Samir, if you need escalation, Priya is on-call for infra and can help with infra-level remediation.
Samir K: noted re: Matt's window. Priya R, can you be reachable for escalations between 07:00-08:00?
Priya R: yes i can. i'll join if pager escalates.
IncidentBot: [pager] Page routed to eng-oncall primary Samir K at 1845678920 for INF-1240 (KV cache follow-up)
Samir K: i'm going to run a quick check and enable temporary autoscale bump on p3pool for the next 2 hours to reduce risk of repeated 503s. i'll document the change.
Anya S: add a note to INF-1240 with the autoscale params and the window. also schedule a short retro tomorrow 10:00UTC.
Samir K: done — INF-1240 comment added and retro scheduled (calendar invite sent to #eng-oncall and infra).
Samir K: action items I/O: 1) infra to evaluate autoscale thresholds (Priya), 2) runtime to add conservative pre-warm on embeddings (Matt), 3) product to verify impacted tenant list & outreach (Anya).
Priya R: i'll own infra eval, will open INF-1241 and assign to infra team for thresholds + cost estimate.
Matt P: i'll add a ticket for runtime pre-warm logic (INF-1242) and include a small benchmark plan.
Anya S: customer comms — we've already flagged incident internally. product will draft a short note for affected tenants after retro.
Samir K: gap note: Matt's 07:00-08:00 meeting leaves a 1h possible coverage gap for deeper runtime changes; Priya is covering infra escalations but runtime fixes may be blocked. i'll note this in the handoff.
Anya S: thanks. leaving the thread now. Samir — primary to you. ping me if anything spikes, otherwise i'll rejoin after 16:00UTC. :wave:
Samir K: thanks! taking over. i'll post updates here for any paging. :thumbsup:
Ops Pager: [system] Reminder: on-call rota shows Matt P secondary until 12:00UTC, then Priya R takes secondary.
Matt P: noted, i'll update my calendar visibility.
Samir K: last note — if you need to escalate to SRE lead, use the channel #eng-sre and tag @sre-lead. runbook link again: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serving-cache-warmup#post-mortem-template
Anya S: thank you all, handoff complete.
